parameters.name: ApiFormat
parameters.description: The API operation.

parameters.name: ApiId
parameters.description: The ID of the API.

parameters.name: ApiMethod
parameters.description:
The request method of the API. Valid values:
- **GET**: GET request.
- **POST**: POST request.
- **HEAD**: HEAD request.
- **PUT**: PUT request.
- **DELETE**: DELETE request.
- **CONNECT**: CONNECT request.
- **PATCH**: PATCH request.
- **OPTIONS**: OPTIONS request.

parameters.name: ApiStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the API. Valid values:
- **NewbornInterface**: newly added.
- **OfflineInterface**: inactive.
- **normal**: normal.

parameters.name: ApiTag
parameters.description:
The business purpose of the API.

> You can call [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) to obtain the supported business purposes.

parameters.name: ApiType
parameters.description:
The service object. Valid values:
- **PublicAPI**: public service.
- **ThirdpartAPI**: third-party collaboration.
- **InternalAPI**: internal office.

parameters.name: AuthFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the API has an authentication field. Valid values:
- **0**: has authentication.
- **1**: does not have authentication.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Follow
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the API is followed. Valid values:
- **1**: followed.
- **0**: not followed.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: MatchedHost
parameters.description: The domain name or IP address to which the API operation belongs.

parameters.name: Note
parameters.description: The remarks.

parameters.name: OrderKey
parameters.description:
The name of the field used for sorting. Valid values:
- **allCnt**: total access volume in the last 30 days.
- **botCnt**: bot access volume in the last 30 days.
- **crossBorderCnt**: cross-border access volume in the last 30 days.
- **abnormalNum**: number of risks associated with the API.
- **eventNum**: number of events associated with the API.
- **farthestTs**: first discovery time.
- **lastestTs**: most recent access time.

parameters.name: OrderWay
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- **desc**: descending order (default).
- **asc**: ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates that each page contains 10 entries.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: RequestSensitiveType
parameters.description:
The type of sensitive information in the request.

> You can call [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) to obtain the supported sensitive information types.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: SensitiveLevel
parameters.description:
The sensitivity level of the API. Valid values:
- **L1**: high sensitivity.
- **L2**: medium sensitivity.
- **L3**: low sensitivity.
- **N**: not sensitive.

parameters.name: SensitiveType
parameters.description:
The type of sensitive data in the response.
> You can call [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) to obtain the supported sensitive data types.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.
